correctness.rationale: For each target A in {left,right,either}, first-reset renewal from y to fixed z gives F_A(y;z)=(1-phi_A(y))/(r phi_A(z)). Independent Neumann/Dirichlet ODEs yield the three phi functions; max(tau_0,tau_L)=tau_0+tau_L-min(tau_0,tau_L) is a pathwise identity even with retained visit flags. With y=L/2 and u=cosh(s(z/L-1/2)), algebra gives H_c(u)=2c(2c^2-1-c)u/(u^2+c^2-1)-(c-1)/u, 1<=u<=c. An independently performed exact SymPy derivative check verifies N_c(u²) and endpoint factorization (c-1)^2(4c³-6c-3)/(c(2c²-1)). The derivative numerator has one positive zero (interior maximum), so endpoints alone compete; critical root c=1.42366105 corresponds rL²/D=3.1738039310. All boundary reset hits count immediately.
residual_risks: Fixed midpoint y, deterministic z, reflecting BM, independent Poisson clock, persistent visit history. No claim about quantiles, non-midpoint starts or joint site/rate optimization.
